title: Salmon Pie
summary: Provides 20 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.

fields.Camp Supplies: 20 points. A full Long Rest normally needs 40 supplies, or 80 on Tactician and Honour.
fields.Acquisition: Available as loot or from traders.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
